02 / AN INVITATION

A letter to investors.

Download letter · PDF

October 10, 2026

Dear prospective investor,

An event begins long before the doors open. It starts when someone decides to attend, registers, and forms a first impression. I am building RegFire to connect that moment to a confident arrival onsite.

The vision is straightforward: one registration platform for ticketed events and events that need named badges. Organizers should be able to shape a branded registration experience, define pricing and attendee paths, and carry that same attendee record through payment, confirmation, check-in, and badge production.

RegFire already has a working local foundation for event configuration and registration previews. The next stage is to validate the complete purchase-to-entry experience in real operating conditions. Reliable payments, secure data handling, tested entry controls, and dependable onsite recovery are essential milestones before a broader commercial launch.

Our initial focus is repeat organizers: associations, conferences, training programs, and selected independent events. The plan calls for a small group of design partners across both ticketing and badging. We will measure setup effort, registration accuracy, arrival performance, and willingness to pay, then use those results to guide the product and business model.

I am looking to connect with investors and strategic partners who understand event operations and share a practical approach to building a durable business. The priorities are product and engineering, payment and security readiness, pilot events, and an operating model that can support customers without losing control of delivery costs.

The accompanying film introduces the vision. The business plan lays out the proposed market focus, launch milestones, risks, and financial scenarios. Its figures are planning assumptions, not achieved results or commitments. Any financing amount and terms will be established through a separate discussion and supporting diligence.

If this is a business you would like to help build, I would welcome a conversation about the roadmap, the evidence still to earn, and where your experience could make a difference.

Thank you for taking the time to learn about RegFire.

Mike Blazejewski
RegFire
blaze@regfire.events
